limitations: One RTX 3060 Laptop GPU; thermal/power throttling observed.
Warm ordinary calls, not a paper sweep or cold-start qualification.
All schedule comparisons keep GPU tokenization enabled.

hardware.build: Release, SM86, general tokenization experiment disabled

method.metric: Complete ordinary public call latency; lower is better.
method.case_change: Ratio of medians across process medians, minus one, percent.
method.aggregate: Geometric mean of per-image latency ratios, minus one, percent.
method.paired_median: Median same-round after/before latency ratios, minus one, percent.
method.environment: All other GJXL overrides unset; GPU tokenization enabled in all arms.
